{{Top|leg}}
The '''Plaza of the Founders''' was a great circular public gathering place near the political district of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It was erected in the wake of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. Among other things, it was the location of [[Cha Niathal]]'s [[Funeral of Cha Niathal|funeral]]. Her memorial included a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] projector showing her life and an eulogy by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]].
